chest_operations_select_own.name: chest_operations_select_own
chest_operations_select_own.using:
exists (
    select 1 from "travelers"
    where "travelers"."id" = "chest_operations"."traveler_id"
      and "travelers"."user_id" = (select auth.uid())
  )
